study: Source-inner range-frequency label-information diagnostic; known transforms and linear probes, not a novel method
representation: Orthonormal DCT-II along range63, preserve all90 time frames. Fixed independent Gaussian projections: low k0..20 to256, high k21..62 to256; mixed concatenates first128 low and last128 high. Same projections across users/views; no fitted transform. metric: Mean class accuracy over held-user present classes; then equal mean of six users

limits: Exploratory reused source users, not independent confirmation
